draft_policy: Skip the heavy Full Regression job while the pull request is draft.
synchronize_policy: Every synchronize event for a non-draft pull request creates a new exact candidate and cancels the previous in-progress Full Regression run for that pull request.
concurrency_policy: One Full Regression run per pull request or manual candidate; cancel-in-progress is true.
required_authority_behavior: Every non-draft candidate enters the Full Regression decision workflow. Final level L preserves the current twenty-one-authority exact-SHA reuse/attach/dispatch contract. Final level S or M records a green risk-authorized bypass of those heavy authorities; F7-02 and independently required CI remain authoritative for their scope. Manual Full Regression dispatch always forces L.

risk_policy.preliminary_source: TEST_LEVEL_PROVISIONAL marker in pull-request body; missing marker fails closed to L
risk_policy.delta_source: complete base SHA to exact candidate SHA diff
risk_policy.decision: final level is max(preliminary, delta); automatic downgrade is forbidden
